description: 인천항만공사_인천항여객터미널 운영정보 조회 서비스 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천항만공사. 해당 자료는 인천항만공사에서 운영하는 인천항 여객터미널에 대한 기본 운영정보를 제공하는 Open API 설명 자료로, 각 선사의 명칭, 개장일시, 최근 운영일자, 전화번호, 회사코드. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 인천항만공사. Its tags are 인천항여객터미널, 운영정보, 선사정보, 연락처, 개장일시. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
